title: Connectors
description: The systems HuiTong connects, their health and their field mappings.

sync.title: Choose a system to sync

descriptions.choose: HuiTong first previews what would change, and writes nothing until you apply the preview.
descriptions.preview: Nothing has been written yet. Check the changes, then slide to apply them.
descriptions.apply: Writing exactly the previewed changes to the employee master. Every change is audited.
descriptions.inSync: The preview compared every record with the employee master.
descriptions.applied: The previewed changes are in the employee master, and each one is in the audit log.
descriptions.partial: Records with errors were skipped. The other changes are in the employee master and the audit log.
descriptions.previewFailed: The preview stopped, so nothing was written. You can preview again.
descriptions.applyFailed: The sync stopped early. Any changes it made are in the audit log; preview again to pick up the rest.

sync.failed: The run stopped with an error.

errors.MAPPING_FAILED: Records could not be mapped to the employee master. Check the field mapping.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Records failed the employee master's checks.
errors.MISSING_EMPLOYEE_NO: Records arrived without an employee number.
errors.INCOMPLETE_RECORD: New records were missing required details.
errors.ENTITY_MISMATCH: Records named a different entity from the one already on file.
errors.INTERRUPTED: The run was interrupted before it finished.
errors.UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: The connected system did not respond.

sync.inSync: Everything is already in sync: there is nothing to apply.

preview.caption: Changes the sync would make
preview.truncated: Showing the first {{count}} changes; the counts above cover all of them.
